parsed.lessons_learned: Oracle prices in this simulation appear to be completely static (ETH: $2800, SOL: $150, BTC: $95K for 8 consecutive cycles). This means futures positions on oracle-priced assets generate ZERO PnL unless the oracle updates. Holding 5 ETH shorts and 3 SOL shorts for 8 cycles while paying opportunity cost on $1,400 of margin was a mistake. Should have recognized the pattern by cycle 4-5 and closed. The ROCKET exit was correctly prioritized but took too many cycles to execute. Key insight: in a frozen oracle environment, AMM-priced tokens (ROCKET, MOON) are where actual PnL can be generated via spot trades, while futures only pay off if oracle actually moves.
